subject: fix(runtime): bound stuck session starts and released-lease memory
instruction:
fix(runtime): bound stuck session starts and released-lease memory

An interactive start waited on :ready with no ceiling of its own, and
the only replies came from persist success or a terminal transition —
so a store that kept failing checkpoints left every caller hanging
with nothing in the log. The coordinator now arms a readiness deadline
when its first waiter registers and answers as
{:session_start_unresolved, id} while polling continues, naming the
retry signature it is stuck on. Durable state is untouched: recovery
still owns the session, and the gateway opens it instead of blocking.
Configured by interactive_readiness_deadline_ms, default ten minutes.

Workspace.Manager recorded every released lease forever so release
retries could be answered idempotently. The ring is now capped —
1000 by default, tunable per instance via :released_tombstone_limit —
evicting oldest first; status for an evicted lease is honestly
:lease_not_found.

Also terminalize before delete in the gateway operate test's cleanup:
a non-terminal holder session whose workspace the same callback
removed poisoned every later full-boot recovery with an unavailable
path. That flake failed two of three clean-tree runs before this.

Acceptance. These tests are restored into the worktree after the session ends and must pass:
  - a coordinator whose checkpoints keep failing answers start waiters at the deadline
  - every operate method is refused on a read listener
  - a refused operate call never reaches a handler
  - the read listener still advertises the operate methods it will refuse
  - answers operate verbs, and refuses their parameters honestly
  - a post-dispatch checkpoint failure is outcome-unknown, not a refusal
  - structured turn input is closed and validated before dispatch
  - steer refuses a false idempotency key and accepts only its actual envelope
  - an option outside the allowlist is refused rather than dropped
  - an unknown provider is a parameter error, not a new atom
  - an enum value outside the schema is refused
  - delete removes a terminal session and refuses a live one

Rules. Files that already exist under `test/` must not be modified or deleted — the change is graded against tests restored from the history after the session ends. New test files of your own are allowed and are left in place. Work only inside this worktree.
